segments.source: Moi etu karone tumike Crete majuli te chari jaise, ki kaam thik nohoi kene thakise eitu khan thik kori bole, aru moi tumike kowa nisena, sheher te girja laga rokhiya kori bole bura khan ke basi lobi.

segments.hypothesis: I left you from Crete, that which was not appropriate, and I said to you, as I have chosen the shepherd of the assembly.

segments.hypothesis: but all things are clean, but not in faith, but in their conscience, but also in their minds and in their hearts, and in the conscience and their conscience.

segments.source: Kintu tumi to hoile, ki kotha koi, etu hosa hisab te sikhai di thakibi.
segments.reference: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
segments.hypothesis: But you are now, teaching according to the truth.

segments.reference: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

segments.reference: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

segments.reference: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

segments.reference: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

segments.reference: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

segments.source: Baba Isor aru Probhu Jisu Khrista laga anugraha aru shanti tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi.
segments.reference: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: Grace to you and peace be with you in the Lord Jesus Christ,

segments.source: Moi hodai Isor ke dhanyavad di thake. Moi laga prathana te tumikhan ke yaad kori thake.
segments.reference: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
segments.hypothesis: I always give thanks to God. I remember you in my prayers.

segments.source: Tumikhan Probhu Jisu Khrista logote morom aru biswas thaka aru ekjon-ekjon logote thaka to moi hunise.
segments.reference: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

segments.reference: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

segments.hypothesis: He therefore has been sanctified for a while, and that you may have received her for an opportunity.

segments.source: Tai aru manu laga sewa nokorile, kintu tai ekjon sewa kora manu pora bhi bhal hoi kene morom thaka bhai hobo. Moi taike bisi morom kore, aru tumike bhi bisi morom kore, mangso pora bhi aru Probhu Jisu laga naam pora bhi.
segments.reference: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
segments.hypothesis: He will not serve, nor do he who is good brother, I love him more than the flesh, and love you more than God.

segments.source: Jodi moi bhi tumikhan laga sathi ase koile, moike jineka tumikhan pora loise etu nisena, taike bhi loi lobi.
segments.reference: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
segments.hypothesis: If I also have your friend, let me also, as you have received, let him also take it.

segments.source: Kintu jodi tai tumikhan logote kiba biya korise aru dibole baki ase koile, etu moi uporte hali dibi.
segments.reference: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
segments.hypothesis: But if he has anything to do with you, let it be poured on me.

segments.source: Moi, Paul, moi laga nijor hath pora etu likhi ase. Moi nijor sob to wapas kori dibo- aru tumikhan nijorke moi logote dibole baki ase!
segments.reference: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
segments.hypothesis: Paul, I, Paul, write my own hand. I will give it back, and you will give me something to give to me.

segments.source: Hoi, bhai, Probhu laga naam pora moi nimite ekta kaam kori dibi; Khrista nimite moi laga mon to taja kori dibi.
segments.reference: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
segments.hypothesis: Yes, brothers, do one thing to me in the Lord's name; and let my heart be tarched, and the Lord for Christ.

segments.source: Tumi pora kotha mani kene thaka to moi bharosa ase. Aru moi kowa kotha pora bhi tumi bisi koribo koi kene moi tumike etu chithi likhi ase.
segments.reference: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
segments.hypothesis: I am confident of you, and I speak to you. I speak that you will do more than this letter.

segments.source: Aru etu logote, etiya moi nimite ekta kamra taiyar kori kene rakhibi, moi asha ase tumi laga prathana pora moi joldi tumi logote wapas ahibo paribo.
segments.reference: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
segments.hypothesis: Now let me go, prepare a upper room for me, that I may come to you immediately.

segments.source: Epaphras, Jisu Khrista laga kaam nimite moi logote bondhi ghor te thaka sathi, tai bhi tumike salam jonai ase.
segments.reference: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
segments.hypothesis: Epaphras, I have a prisoner to you, the prisoner, who is also the greeting you.

segments.source: Mark, Aristarach, Demas, aru Luke, moi logot kaam kori thaka khan sob pora bhi salam jonai ase.
segments.reference: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
segments.hypothesis: Mark, Aristarch, Dema, and Luke, greets, my fellow workers.

segments.source: Jisu Khrista laga anugrah tumikhan sob logot hodai thaki bole dibi. Amen.
segments.reference: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: The grace of Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

segments.source: Kuntu shuru pora thakise- juntu moi khan hunise, aru suku pora dikhise, juntu moi khan saise, aru amikhan laga hath pora dhorise, eitu khan sob jibon laga kotha ase.
segments.reference: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
segments.hypothesis: For which was from the beginning, which I heard, and the eyes saw, the eyes which we looked, and our hand is the word of all life.

segments.source: Aru, etu jibon amikhan ke janibole dise, aru amikhan etu laga gawahi ase. Moi apuni khan ke anonto jibon laga kotha koi ase, jun to Baba Isor logote ase, aru etu kotha amikhan ke janibole nimite dise.
segments.reference: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
segments.hypothesis: and made known to us the promise of our life, and we have testified to you of the eternal life which is in the Father, and to know the word of our God.

segments.source: Amikhan ki hunise aru dikhise, etu sob apuni khan ke koidi ase, etu pora amikhan sob mili kene thakibo. Aru, amikhan Baba aru Tai laga Putro, Jisu Khrista logote milikena ase.
segments.reference: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: But we have heard and have all things that we have been told you, that we all may be together with this, and we have the Father and his Son, with Christ Jesus.

segments.source: Aru, amikhan to apuni khan nimite etu kotha khan likhi ase etu pora apuni khan khushi kori thaka to pura hoi jabo nimite.
segments.reference: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
segments.hypothesis: We are persuaded that you will be made to complete the things which are for you.

segments.source: Amikhan etu kotha Isor laga Putro Jisu Khrista logot pora hunise aru apuni khan ke koi ase: Isor to puhor ase, aru Tai logote eku andhera nai.
segments.reference: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
segments.hypothesis: We have heard the word of God in Christ Jesus, and God is called to you. He has no light, and has no darkness.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan Tai logote milikena ase koi aru andhar laga rasta te berai, titia amikhan misa koi ase aru hosa laga kotha khan mani kene thaka nohoi jai.
segments.reference: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
segments.hypothesis: If we are with him, we walk in the way of darkness, that we speak falsely and not to the truth of truth.

segments.source: Kintu jodi amikhan ujala te berai jineka Tai ujala te thake, amikhan ekjon-ekjon logote milikena ase, aru Tai laga Putro Jisu laga khun pora amikhan laga sob paap to sapha kori diye.
segments.reference: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
segments.hypothesis: But if we walk in the light, we are one in the darkness, and the blood of his Son, through the blood that is in us.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan paap nai koi, titia amikhan nijorke thogai ase, aru hosa to moi khan logote nai.
segments.reference: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
segments.hypothesis: If we don't sin, we are deceiveful, and the truth didn't come to us.

segments.source: Kintu jodi amikhan pora Isor ke amikhan laga paapkhan shikar kore, titia Tai hosa thaka pora amikhan laga paapkhan maph kori dibo aru sob adharmikta pora sapha kori dibo.
segments.reference: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
segments.hypothesis: But if we confess God our sins, he will forgive our sins through the truth, and every unrighteousness will make arche of unrighteousness.

segments.source: Jodi amikhan paap kora nai koile, amikhan Taike misa bonai di ase, aru Tai laga kotha amikhan logote nai.
segments.reference: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
segments.hypothesis: If we don't sin, we make him wrong, and have no such as we have his word.

segments.source: Ami laga bacha khan, moi tumikhan ke etu likhi ase tumikhan paap nokorile nimite. Kintu jodi kunba paap kore, amikhan laga Baba Isor logote kotha kori diya ekjon ase, Jisu Khrista, kun dharmik ase.
segments.reference: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
segments.hypothesis: My children, I don't sin. But if anyone does sin, we speak to one of our God, who is Christ, Jesus, who speaks righteously.

segments.source: Tai amikhan laga paap maph kori diya ekjon ase, aru khali amikhan ekla nimite nohoi, kintu pura duniya nimite.
segments.reference: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
segments.hypothesis: He is a forgiveer of our sins, and not only for us alone, but for the whole world.

segments.source: Etu pora amikhan Taike jani loise, jodi amikhan Tai laga adesh khan mani kene thake koile.
segments.reference: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
segments.hypothesis: For we know him, if we are persuaded by him.

segments.source: Kun manu koi, “Moi Isor ke jane,” kintu kotha mani kene nathake, tai misa kowa manu ase, aru tai logote hosa nai.
segments.reference: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
segments.hypothesis: He who says, "I know God," but not obeyed, but to the liars, and he is not true.

segments.source: Kintu kun manu Isor laga kotha mane, tai logot te Isor laga morom to sob phale bhal bonai dise. Etu pora amikhan jane amikhan Tai logote ase:
segments.reference: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
segments.hypothesis: But we know that those who are of God's word has been made good to God on all things, we know we have him:

segments.source: kun manu tai Isor logote ase koi, Khrista jineka beraise, etu nisena tai bhi bera bole lage.
segments.reference: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
segments.hypothesis: who is in God, as Christ also walks, so he also needs to walk.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, moi tumikhan ke notun niyom likha nohoi, hoilebi kuntu purana niyom tumikhan logote shuru pora ase, etu he koi ase. Etu purana niyom he tumikhan huni thaka laga kotha ase.
segments.reference: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
segments.hypothesis: But I dont write to you, brothers, but the old covenant that you have the first covenant, which is of the old law, this is the old commandment which you hear.

segments.source: Hoilebi moi tumikhan nimite notun niyom likhi di ase, juntu niyom Khrista aru tumikhan usorte hosa ase, kelemane andhera to jai ase, aru hosa laga puhor to juli ase.
segments.reference: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
segments.hypothesis: But I wrote a new covenant to you, which is the truth of the law and truth in Christ, for the darkness is burned with the light of truth.

segments.source: Kun manu ujala te ase eneka koi, aru nijor laga bhai bhoini khan ke ghin kore, tai etiya bhi andhera te ase.
segments.reference: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
segments.hypothesis: He who is in light says, and his sisters are still in darkness.

segments.source: Kun manu tai laga bhai ke morom kore tai ujala te ase aru tai kitia bhi biya rasta te nagiribo.
segments.reference: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
segments.hypothesis: For he who loves his brother is in light and never enters into the way into the evil way.

segments.source: Kintu kun manu tai laga bhai ke ghin kore tai andhera te ase aru andhera te berai ase. Tai kote jai ase tai nijor bhi najane, kelemane andhera pora tai laga suku andha kori dise.
segments.reference: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
segments.hypothesis: But he who hates his brother is in darkness and walk in darkness. Where he has no idea, he has made his own eyes blind.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan ke likhi ase, morom laga bacha khan, kelemane Khrista laga naam pora tumikhan laga paap maph paise.
segments.reference: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
segments.hypothesis: I write to you, children of love, for your sins are forgiven you in Christ.

segments.source: Moi apuni khan ke likhi ase, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane utu ekjon kun ase, jun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan nimite likhi ase, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan biya ekjon logote jiti loise.
segments.reference: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
segments.hypothesis: I write to you, fathers, for you know who the beginning is to you who are of the beginning. I write you, for the young men, for your reward has been made with a man.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan ke likhi dise, chutu bacha khan, kelemane tumikhan Baba Isor ke jane. Moi etu apuni khan ke likhise, baba khan, kelemane apuni khan jane etu ekjon ke kun shuru pora ase. Moi tumikhan ke likhise, jawan manu khan, kelemane tumikhan takot ase, aru Isor laga kotha tumikhan logote ase, aru tumikhan biya uporte jiti loise.
segments.reference: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
segments.hypothesis: I wrote to you, little children, for you know God, and I wrote this: for you yourselves know that one of these things I have been written before you, for I have received your hearts and your hearts to you.

segments.source: Etu duniya ke morom nokoribi aru etu duniya te thaka jinis khan ke morom nokoribi. Jodi kunba manu etu duniya ke morom kore, titia tai logote Baba Isor laga morom nai.
segments.reference: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
segments.hypothesis: Dont love the world, nor do the things which are in the world. If anyone loves this world, he doesn't have the beloved God of the Father.

segments.source: Kelemane ki to etu duniya te ase- mangso laga itcha, aru suku laga itcha, aru jibon laga phutani- etu Baba pora nohoi kintu etu duniya laga ase.
segments.reference: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
segments.hypothesis: For the will of the world, and the will in the world; and the glory of the living, not of the Father, but of this world.

segments.source: Etu duniya aru tai laga itcha khan khotom hoi ase. Kintu kun manu Isor laga itcha pora thake tai hodai thakibo.
segments.reference: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
segments.hypothesis: These things are destroyed, and the will of the world. But he who endures the wills of God will be forever.

segments.source: Chutu bacha khan, etu hekh laga homoi ase. Tumikhan Khrista bhirodhi ahi ase koi kene hunise, aru etiya to bisi Khrista bhirodhi jon ahi jaise. Etu pora amikhan jane hekh homoi to ahise.
segments.reference: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
segments.hypothesis: You children, have days of the end. You have heard the Christ coming, and have many times come against us. We know the last time.

segments.source: Khrista ke bhirodh kora khan to amikhan pora ulaikene jaise, kintu taikhan to amikhan pora nohoi. Jodi taikhan to amikhan pora ase koile amikhan logote thaki bole asele. Kintu jitia taikhan ulaikene jaise, etu pora jani loise taikhan kun bhi amikhan pora nohoi.
segments.reference: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
segments.hypothesis: The multitude of the multitude came out of us, and they were not from us. If they were us, they were all coming out of the time, and the one who had been taken away from us, so no one who knew it.

segments.source: Kintu tumikhan Pobitro Ekjon pora asirbad paise, aru tumikhan sob hosa jani ase.
segments.reference: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
segments.hypothesis: But you have received the Holy One blessing, and you all know the truth.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan hosa najane koi kene etu likha nai, kintu tumikhan jani ase aru hosa te eku misa nai.
segments.reference: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
segments.hypothesis: I don't write the truth, that you don' yet know that which is true and you know that nothing is wrong.

segments.source: Kun misa kowa jon ase, tai ekjon, jun pora Jisu he Khrista ase koi kene mana kore? Etu manu Khrista bhirodhi ase, kelemane tai Baba aru Putro ke mana kori ase.
segments.reference: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
segments.hypothesis: Who is false, who obey Jesus Christ? This man is Christ, because he does the Son of the Son, because his Father has kept the Son and the Son.

segments.source: Kun manu Jisu ke mana kore tai laga Baba nai. Kun manu Jisu ke loi, tai logote Baba ase.
segments.reference: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
segments.hypothesis: He who keeps Jesus doesn't have the Father. He who takes him is the Father, is the God of the Father;

segments.source: Aru tumikhan to, shuru pora ki kotha hunise etu tumikhan logote thaki bole dibi. Jodi tumikhan shuru pora ki hunise etu monte rakhe koile, tumikhan hodai Putro aru Baba logote thakibo.
segments.reference: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
segments.hypothesis: You, let your hand be with the words of the beginning. If you have heard from the beginning, you will always be with your Father.

segments.source: Etu kosom Khrista pora amikhan ke dise- anonto jibon.
segments.reference: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
segments.hypothesis: that promised we were given eternal life.

segments.source: Moi etu kotha tumikhan nimite likhi ase, utu manu karone bhi kun pora tumikhan ke biya rasta te loijabo.
segments.reference: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
segments.hypothesis: I write these things to you, that no one will bring you into the way of the man.

segments.source: Aru tumikhan to, ki asirbad tumikhan Khrista pora paise etu tumikhan logote he ase, aru dusra pora tumikhan ke sikhai dibole dorkar nai. Kintu Tai laga asirbad pora ki sikhai dise etu hosa ase aru misa nohoi, aru tumikhan ke sikhai diya nisena, Tai logote thakibi.
segments.reference: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
segments.hypothesis: You are blessed, and don't need for the rest of the blessing which you have received, but the true and not in vain, and you as he has learned.

segments.source: Etiya, bacha khan, Tai logote thakibi, jitia Tai wapas ahibo, moi khan mon dangor koribo aru Tai aha homoi te sorom nakhabo.
segments.reference: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
segments.hypothesis: Now, children, be with him, when he comes, lets not be disappointed in his coming.

segments.source: Jodi tumi jane Tai dharmik ase koi kene, titia hoile tumikhan etu bhi jani thakibo kun manu thik kaam kore tai Isor pora jonom hoise.
segments.reference: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
segments.hypothesis: If you know that he is righteous, yet you will know that which he does well, and he who is born of God has been born.

segments.source: Sabi Isor pora kineka morom amikhan ke dise, eneka pora amikhan Isor laga bacha ase kobole nimite, aru hosa pora bhi amikhan to Tai laga bacha khan ase. Etu karone, prithibi pora amikhan ke najane, kelemane taikhan Isor ke najane.
segments.reference: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
segments.hypothesis: Behold, we have given mercy to God, that we may be children of God, and we know the children of his truth, for God doesn't know us in the world, for they don't have God.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai khan, amikhan etiya Isor laga bacha khan ase aru amikhan ki hobo etu etiya bhi dikhai diya nai. Amikhan jane jitia Khrista ahibo, amikhan Tai nisena hoi jabo, kelemane Tai kineka ase etu nisena amikhan Taike dikhibo.
segments.reference: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
segments.hypothesis: Love, we are children of God, and have not yet seen the things that are to happen. We know that when Christ comes, we will see the same thing as he is.

segments.source: Kun manu Khrista uporte asha rakhe, Khrista sapha thaka nisena, etu manu khan bhi nijorke sapha kori loi.
segments.reference: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
segments.hypothesis: For as Christ is hope, even as the fullness of the saints who are sanctified, even so also the saints.

segments.source: Kun paap kaam khan kori ase tai niyom khan mani kene thaka manu nohoi, kelemane paap te niyom nai.
segments.reference: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
segments.hypothesis: For those who sin are not under the law, for there is no law, because of sin.

segments.source: Tumikhan jane Khrista ke dikhai diya to paapkhan hatai dibole nimite hoise, aru Tai logote eku paap nai.
segments.reference: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
segments.hypothesis: You know that Christ has been made to lose sins, and have no sin.

segments.source: Kun manu Khrista logote thake, tai aru paap kaam nakore. Aru kun manu paap kaam kore, tai Isor ke dikha nai, aru Taike janibole para nai.
segments.reference: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
segments.hypothesis: He who lives in Christ doesn't sin nor sin; but he who does sin, he didnt see God, nor knows him.

segments.source: Morom laga bacha khan, kun pora bhi tumike biya rasta te loi jabole nadibi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai dharmik ase, Khrista dharmik thaka nisena.
segments.reference: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
segments.hypothesis: Love not be taken by love, for he who does good works is righteous, as the righteous.

segments.source: Kun manu paap kaam khan kore tai saitan laga ase, kelemane saitan bhi shuru pora paap kaam kori kene ahise. Etu nimite Isor laga Putro ke dikhai dise, aru Tai pora saitan laga kaam khan khotom kori dibole.
segments.reference: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
segments.hypothesis: For he who does sin is the devil, for the devil has been in the beginning, has revealed God's Son, and has made the devil to destroy the work of the devil.

segments.source: Kun manu Isor pora jonom loise tai biya kaam kori kene nathake kelemane Isor laga bijon tai logote ase. Tai paap kori kene thaki bole napare kelemane tai Isor pora jonom hoise.
segments.reference: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
segments.hypothesis: For he who has born God has not been counted with evil, because he has the seed of God, he can't sin, because God has been born through God.

segments.source: Etu pora Isor laga bacha khan aru saitan laga bacha khan ke dikhai diye: Kun manu dharmik kaam nakore tai Isor laga nohoi, aru kun manu tai nijor laga bhai ke morom nakore tai bhi Isor laga nohoi.
segments.reference: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
segments.hypothesis: God revealed the children of the children and the devil, who does not a righteous work, nor does it, nor of him who loves his brother.

segments.source: Kelemane tumikhan shuru pora etu kotha huni kene ahise, amikhan ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori bole lage.

segments.source: Etu morom ase, ki amikhan Tai laga hukum hisab te berai kene jabole lage. Etu hukum ase juntu shuru pora tumi hunise juntu laga rasta te tumi bera bole lage.
segments.reference: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
segments.hypothesis: "You are love, we must walk according to the commandment of him, that you may walk according as the beginning, that your hearing you may have the way of the light.

segments.source: Kelemane manu khan ke thogai diya duniya te bisi jai kene ase, aru taikhan etu shikar nakore Jisu Khrista sharir hoi kene ahise. Tai thogai diya manu aru Khrista bhirodhi ase.
segments.reference: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
segments.hypothesis: For the same way of the deceit of the world is a great multitude, and they didnt confess that Jesus Christ was a body, came to him, having a fool who was Christ, and the deceiver of Christ.

segments.source: Nijorke sai lobi, amikhan ki nimite kaam kori sele tumi etu naharabo karone, kintu etu pora tumi pura iman to pabo.
segments.reference: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
segments.hypothesis: Watch yourself, take care of what we have been through the work which you have done, but that you may receive the whole.

segments.source: Kun manu Jisu Khrista pora ki sikhai dise etu noloikene age jai, titia hoile tai logote Isor nai. Kun manu etu kotha khan mani kene thake, tai logote Baba aru Putro duijon bhi ase.
segments.reference: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
segments.hypothesis: He who is not able to follow after the things which Jesus had learned, is not with him. He who obeys, let him be with the Son and the Son of the Father.

segments.source: Kun manu tumi laga usorte ahe aru eneka nahikai, taike ghor bhitor te namati bhi aru taike salam nadibi.
segments.reference: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
segments.hypothesis: "Let no one who comes to you, greets you, and don't enter into your house.

segments.source: Kun taike salam diye, tai laga biya kaam khan te tai bhi bhag loijai.
segments.reference: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
segments.hypothesis: He who greets him, he also takes a share of his evildoers.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan logote bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kagos te aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan likhi bole mon nai. Hoilebi, moi tumikhan logote ahi kene ekjon-ekjon logote kotha kori bole mon ase, etu pora tumikhan laga khushi aru bhi bisi dangor hobo.
segments.reference: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
segments.hypothesis: I have many things to write to you, but I don't like to write this book. But I have come to you and to speak to one another, that your joy may be great and more than you.

segments.source: Tumikhan pora basi luwa bhoini laga bacha khan pora bhi tumike salam di ase.
segments.reference: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: Greet you the chosen sisters, the chosen ones, the children of the chosen chosen ones.

segments.source: Bura manu pora morom thaka Gaius ekjon cholawta ke likhi ase, kunke moi hosa pora morom kore.
segments.reference: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
segments.hypothesis: Gaius, a man who is beloved, a ruler, who is faithful.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai, Moi prathana kore tumi logote sob bhal thakibo aru tumi laga gaw bhi bhal thakibo, tumi laga atma bhal kori kene thaka nisena.
segments.reference: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
segments.hypothesis: "A brother, I pray to you, that you may be all good, and your body be healed, as your spirit, your spirit is made.

segments.source: Kelemane moi khushi pai jitia bhai khan ahi kene tumi hosa te berai thaka laga gawahi diye, tumi hosa te berai thaka nisena.
segments.reference: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
segments.hypothesis: For I rejoice when the brothers come and testify of the truth, you walk as walk in the truth.

segments.source: Moi etu pora aru dangor khushi nai, jitia ami laga bacha khan hosa rasta te berai ase koi kene moi hune.
segments.reference: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
segments.hypothesis: I was not so glad that when my children are walking on the road.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai, tumi biswas pora ki kori ase etu tumi bhai khan nimite aru bahar manu khan nimite kori ase
segments.reference: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.
segments.hypothesis: "You brother, you do the faith which is through your brother to the brothers, and to the Gentiles,

segments.source: kun pora tumikhan laga morom kora laga gawahi girja manu khan laga usorte dise. Isor laga usorte bhal mohima hobole nimite tumi manu ke bhal pora saikene taikhan ke safar kori bole pathai dibi,
segments.reference: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,
segments.hypothesis: who testified to your beloved, to the assembly of the assembly, that you may be good to the glory of God, and your people, and send them out,

segments.source: kelemane Isor laga naam nimite taikhan ulaikene jaise, aru Porjati manu khan pora eku luwa nai.
segments.reference: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
segments.hypothesis: for they went out for the name of God, and the Gentiles didnt receive anything from them.

segments.source: Amikhan bhi taikhan ke mati bole lage, etu pora amikhan bhi hosa te kaam kora sathi hoi jabo.
segments.reference: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
segments.hypothesis: We also need to call them, so we may be friends with the truth.

segments.source: Moi manu khan nimite kiba likhise, kintu Diotrephes, kun manu laga age te thaki bole nimite bhal pai, tai amikhan ke swekar nakore.
segments.reference: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.
segments.hypothesis: I wrote something to men, but for the sake of the Diotrephes, he who has good for the people, he doesn't receive us.

segments.source: Jodi moi ahe, Moi tai ki kaam kori ase etu sabo, amikhan laga bhirodh te biya kotha kori ase. Kintu eneka kori kene bhi khushi panai, tai nijor pora bhi bhai kokai khan ke mati bole mon nai, aru kun manu ke mati bole mon kore taikhan ke rukhai diye aru girja laga bahar te ulai diye.
segments.reference: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.
segments.hypothesis: If I come, I will see what he does, and we speak evil against our hearts. But he didnt rejoice, but would not have called brothers brothers, and no one will keep the assembly.

segments.source: Morom laga bhai, biya kaam khan nokoribi kintu ki to bhal kaam ase etu he koribi. Kun manu bhal kaam kore tai Isor laga ase; aru kun manu biya kaam kore tai Isor ke dikha nai.
segments.reference: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.
segments.hypothesis: "Don't do the same thing, brothers, but do good works, and don't receive the evil work of God; and those who do evildoers are without God.

segments.source: Demetrius ke sob manu pora aru hosa pora tai nijor laga gawahi diye. Kintu amikhan bhi gawahi diye, aru tumikhan jane amikhan laga gawahi to hosa ase.
segments.reference: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
segments.hypothesis: For every man who gives a testimony to a man and true, but we testify also, and you know that our testimony is true.

segments.source: Moi tumikhan ke bisi kotha likhi bole ase, kintu moi kolom aru siyahi pora etu kotha khan tumikhan ke likhi bole mon nai.
segments.reference: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
segments.hypothesis: I want you to write more to me, but I don't want to write these things with collools and cots.

segments.source: Kintu moi tumikhan ke joldi lok pabole itcha kori ase, titia moi khan ekjon-ekjon logote bohi kene kotha koribo. Tumikhan logote shanti thaki bole dibi. Sathi khan bhi tumikhan ke salam di ase. Naam loi kene ta te thaka sathi khan ke salam di dibi.
segments.reference: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.
segments.hypothesis: But I desire to meet you soon, that I may sit together with one another, and be with you peace. Greet Picians, and greet you. Or greet you in the greeting.

segments.source: Jude, Jisu Khrista laga ekjon noukar, aru moi James laga bhai, pora likhi ase kunkhan ke mati loise, Baba Isor laga morom kora khan, aru Jisu Khrista nimite rakhise:
segments.reference: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:
segments.hypothesis: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and my brother, which is called James, the beloved of God, and the Father, and Christ Jesus:

segments.source: Daya aru shanti aru morom apuni khan logote bhorta hoi thaki bole dibo.
segments.reference: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
segments.hypothesis: The dina and peace will be filled with you and love.

segments.source: Morom thaka bhai khan, moi khan laga poritran pabole laga kotha apuni khan logote likhi bole kosis korise, aru moi apuni khan ke mon dangor kori dibole nimite etu bhi likhi ase pobitro manu khan nimite ki kaam kori bole dise etu biswas aru mon pora dukh uthaikene hoile bhi kori kene thakibi.
segments.reference: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.
segments.hypothesis: Brothers, beloved, we have been trying to write to you the salvation of salvation, that I may establish you, that you may also be persuaded and be persuaded to do the faith of our faith and the faith.

segments.source: Kelemane apuni khan majot pora kunba manu khan lukai kene biya rasta te jaise, kunkhan ke poila pora letera kaam kori dibole nimite pathaise, etu biya manu khan pora mangso laga itcha loi kene Isor laga morom logot bodli kori dise, aru taikhan Jisu Khrista Probhu aru Malik ase koi kene namane.
segments.reference: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: For among you, as many as have fallen into the hidden things which are called to be defiled, which are sent to do evil, to the lusts of God, and to not to be changed into the sight of God and not to obey Christ Jesus.

segments.source: Etiya moi apuni khan ke etu kobole nimite itcha kori ase- apuni khan etu sob jani kene thakile bhi- Jisu pora Egypt desh pora manu khan ke bachai loise, kintu pichete kunkhan Taike biswas kora nai taikhan ke khotom kori dise.
segments.reference: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.
segments.hypothesis: Now I desire to tell you, if you know these things, though you have been saved through Egypt, and have not destroyed those who have believed in him.

segments.source: Aru sorgodoth kunkhan nijor laga adhikar diya to bhal pora chola nai, kintu taike diya asol jaga to chari dise- Isor pora taikhan ke kitia bhi khuli bole napara laga loha rusi pora bandhi dise, andhera jagate, jitia tak Isor laga bisar laga din ahi kene napunche.
segments.reference: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.
segments.hypothesis: The angels who had the power of the angels, and the first time left him, and they were released by God to open them, until the day of God comes,

segments.source: Sodom aru Gomorrah aru usorte thaka sheher dusra khan ke kora nisena he, taikhan bhi nijorke bebichari laga kaam te nijorke hali se, aru ki to Isor pora kori bole diya nai etu laga biya itcha kaam khan he korise. Taikhan dusra manu khan nimite ekta sakhi hoise kunkhan norok laga anonto jui te dukh paikene jolibo.
segments.reference: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
segments.hypothesis: Now as those who were in Sodom and Gomorrah, they also cast themselves into sexual immorality, and what is not prepared for God, that they may be made a testimony to the rest of those who have been made made made with fire, and the fire of the fire which had been made for the end.

segments.source: Etu nisena he, sapna dikhi thaka manu khan bhi nijor laga gaw letera kori ase. Kintu taikhan Isor laga adhikar ke mana nai, aru taikhan mohima te thaka khan uporte biya kotha khan kori thake.
segments.reference: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
segments.hypothesis: Even so, even so, men who see the flesh are defiled, but they don't obey God, and the glory which are in them.

segments.source: Kintu prodhan sorgodoth Michael bhi, jitia tai bhoot logote lorai kori thakise aru Moses laga morija gaw nimite kotha namili kene thakise, tai uporte ekdom biya laga bisar ani diya nai. Kintu tai koise, “Probhu he tumike gali dibi!”
segments.reference: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”
segments.hypothesis: But when the chief angel was fighting against the devil, and the dead of Moses, didnt give a stumbling block to him, but said, "Lord, let you rebuke you!"

segments.source: Kintu etu manu khan pora taikhan bujibo napara khan laga biya kotha koi kene berai thake, aru taikhan nijor laga ki bhabona pora eneka kore, ekta bhal-biya janibo napara janwar nisena, etu pora he taikhan ke khotom kori diye.
segments.reference: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.
segments.hypothesis: But these men walk their unreadless things, and their own conscience as an evil man, as not a buji, even as an unsssisterreed animal animal to destroy them.

segments.source: Hai ase taikhan ke! Kelemane taikhan Cain laga rasta te beraise aru Balaam pora galti kora nisena, kiba labh pabole nimite bisarise. Taikhan Korah pora kotha namani kene thaka logote nijorke harai dise.
segments.reference: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.
segments.hypothesis: Woe to them, because they were walking in the way of Cain, and in the power of Creator, seeking gain, and they have lost their own selves.

segments.source: Eitu khan to hoile apuni khan morom laga kha luwa jagate lukai kene thaka ta te ulai thaka jongol nisena ase, aru apuni khan logote sorom nathaki kene eke logote kha luwa kore- taikhan mer rukha manu khan ase kun nijor he khilai. Taikhan pani nathaka badal nisena he ase, aru hawa pora loijai. Taikhan sukha mohina laga ghas te phul ulabole napara nisena he ase- duibar morise, aru jor pora ulaikene phelai dise.
segments.reference: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
segments.hypothesis: that you are as if you are a hidden in love, like a tree, and the winds, and those who have no root, and they cast out the same thing, and have become like the clouds of the air, and are made with them.

segments.source: Taikhan samundar te biya hawa jai thaka nisena ase, taikhan nijor laga sorom to ulaikene dikhai ase. Taikhan eku asha nathakikena berai thaka tara nisena he ase, aru tai nimite dukh laga andhera to hodai nimite rakhidise.
segments.reference: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
segments.hypothesis: They are as westered by the sea, as their own reproaches are, as though they walk in hope, and the darkness had been reserved for him.

segments.source: Kintu Enoch bhi, jun Adam laga piche aha ekjon ase, taikhan nimite eneka bhabobani korise, aru koise, “Sabi! Probhu Tai laga hajar-hajar pobitro khan pora thaka khan ke loi kene ani ase.
segments.reference: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,
segments.hypothesis: But he who is coming after Adam, prophesied, saying, "Behold, the Lord, the thousands of many thousands, and the saints are driven by the saints.

segments.source: Tai sob uporte bisar kori bole nimite ahi ase. Kunkhan Isor pora bhal napa laga sob kisim laga beya kaam kori kene thaki ase, aru kiman paapi manu jun Isor ke bhoi nakori kene tai laga uporte bisi biya kotha koise, eitu khan sob laga uporte bisar kori bole nimite Isor ahi ase.”
segments.reference: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”
segments.hypothesis: He comes to judge all things, that God has been made a judge for all kinds of things, and to be judged by those who are not of the people who fear God, and that he may be judged.

segments.source: Taikhan dusra logote khushi pora nathaka manu, hodai manu laga biya kotha koi thaka manu, nijor laga biya itcha te berai thaka manu khan ase. Taikhan laga mukh pora phutani laga kotha ulai thake, kun, nijor laga labh nimite dusra manu ke phusla laga kotha kori kene berai thake.
segments.reference: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.
segments.hypothesis: They are not a man who is happy, always speak evil to men, and to walk after their own lips, to the fruit of their own own own glory, who makes the things of the people.

segments.source: Kintu apuni, morom laga bhai khan, Probhu Jisu Khrista laga apostle khan pora age te ki koi dise eitu khan sob yaad koribi.
segments.reference: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
segments.hypothesis: But you, brothers, remember the things which are spoken before Jesus Christ, the apostles of the Lord, remember what things are before you.

segments.source: Taikhan pora apnikhan ke koise, “Duniya khotom hobole thaka homoi te misa kowa manu khan ulabo aru taikhan nijor laga biya itcha pichete he jabo.”
segments.reference: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
segments.hypothesis: saying, "Beell will come out of the people who are falsely, and they will be made made of their own evil desire."

segments.source: Eitu khan nimite he sob bhag hoi kene alag hoijai ase; taikhan duniya laga ase aru taikhan logote Isor laga Atma nai.
segments.reference: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.
segments.hypothesis: For this cause they are members, and are divided, and have no Spirit of the world.

segments.source: Kintu apnikhan, morom laga bhai khan, dangor pobitro biswas pora apnikhan nijorke bonai lobi, aru Pobitro Atma pora prathana koribi.
segments.reference: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.
segments.hypothesis: But you, brothers, be perfected by the holy holy faith, and pray with the Holy Spirit.

segments.source: Apnikhan nijorke Isor laga morom te rakhibi, aru Jisu Khrista laga anonto jibon aru daya nimite rukhi thakibi.
segments.reference: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
segments.hypothesis: that you be in the love of God, and wait for the eternal life and mercy of Jesus Christ.

segments.source: Kun manu biswas nakori kene thaki ase tai uporte bhi daya koribi.
segments.reference: On some have compassion, making a distinction,
segments.hypothesis: Let him who is without faith be merciful.

segments.source: Kintu dusra manu khan ke jui pora ulaikene bachai lobi. Isor ke bhoi koribi aru dusra khan uporte daya koribi. Aru mangso laga itcha pora letera kora kapra ke ghin koribi.
segments.reference: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
segments.hypothesis: But save others, and be merciful to the fire, and hate the flesh; and the lusts of the flesh.

segments.source: Etiya ekjon jun apnikhan ke giribole thaka pora bachai kene rakhe aru Tai laga mohima usorte eku golti aru letera nathaki kene khushi pora khara kori bole diye,
segments.reference: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,
segments.hypothesis: Now he who endures you with a stumbling block, let him stand firm in the sight of his glory,

segments.source: amikhan laga Isor aru Tran-korta Probhu Jisu Khrista ke, mohima hobole dibi, Tai laga mohanta, aru sob uporte raj kori bole dibi, aru takot, sob homoi te, etiya aru hodai tak thaki bole dibo. Amen.
segments.reference: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
segments.hypothesis: to the God and Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ, the great and the mighty, and to reign over all, and the power, the power of the power will be forever and ever. Amen.
